content:
Hey all, since attendance has been low for bi-weekly JS meetings as of late -- let's move to a model where anyone with topics to present/update everyone on brings them up otherwise we cancel.

If you've got something to discuss for the next JS meeting (2026/08/20), drop it in here -- if by the 20th no one has anything to discuss, we'll cancel.

Looks like there aren't any specific things to discuss for the JS meeting this week, will cancel if no one has anything in particular!

Note that releases for Jco and related projects are still going out (lots of bugfixes and features over the last couple weeks), so those are still a great place to keep up.
